narrative.overview:
The page is the B3 trading floor's quote board after dark, seen through royal-blue glass: the Composite's prices drift in one band under a chrome nameplate, and every section below is a lit panel on that floor. Streamlit's native theme (`.streamlit/config.toml`, light and dark) stays underneath and writes all text, widgets and dataframes; the appearances in `ui/aparencia.py` repaint only grounds, panels, hairlines and the nameplate. No code API sets the native theme, so each appearance ships a light and a dark variant and follows whichever type the native menu reports.

Three appearances, picked top right and kept in the URL (`?aparencia=`): **Royal cromado** (default), **Grafite prateado** (the same system on graphite), and **Padrão do Streamlit** (native colors, no injected stylesheet). In the native appearance the quote band and the bordered section panels stay, because they carry content, not decoration. Contrast is WCAG 2.1 AA in every pairing, held by `tests/test_tema.py` and `tests/test_aparencia.py`.
keyCharacteristics: Dark royal or graphite gradient ground (160deg, fixed) with a slow two-spot aurora behind the content.
Translucent glass panels with one 1px hairline and a lit silver top edge.
One four-step magnitude ramp for every number; tabular numerals throughout.
Colour quarantined to the shell, data series and states; prose stays neutral.

rules.name: The One Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every edge on the page is 1px at one alpha: 0.18 on dark, 0.14 on light. The quote band uses the Royal hairline in every appearance. The only exception is a panel's top edge (see Elevation).

rules.name: The Quarantined Colour Rule
rules.body: Prose stays in native neutrals. Colour lives in the shell (ground, aurora, picker), the data series and the up/down states.

rules.name: The Ten Slots Rule
rules.body: Each native type carries exactly ten `chartCategoricalColors`, one per slot of Streamlit's Plotly template; fewer and Plotly drops the theme colors. Light: #2A4FC8, #5A6478, #137A4B, #C0392B, #6D3FC0, #0E7C8C, #8A6A10, #A04B00, #3D4B66, #9C2F6B. Dark: #7B96F0, #C9D1E0, #4CC38A, #F08A76, #B39BF0, #4FC1D6, #D4AF37, #E39B4B, #9AA6BF, #F2A7C3. Each holds 3:1 on its grounds. Charts never set their own color range.

rules.name: The Magnitude Ramp Rule
rules.body: Numbers take one of four sizes: 2rem (headline figure), 1.25rem (price), 1rem (ticker), 0.8125rem (change and labels). No fifth size; tabular numerals on all of them.

rules.name: The Produced Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome is a raster asset (marca/nome-cromado-*.webp from scripts/nome_cromado.py), never CSS gradient text, which read as a grey fade at review. The h1 stays for screen readers, visually hidden.

rules.name: The Still Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels have no hover state and never translate. The "chrome" is one lit top edge: the secondary text color at 0.42 alpha on the 1px border, a hairline, never a stripe or pseudo-element bar.

rules.name: The Slow Flow Rule
rules.body: Motion is ambient and slow: the aurora drifts on a 38s ease-in-out loop; the band moves linearly over max(30s, 5s per ticker), pauses on hover and keyboard focus, and both stop under reduced motion.

dos: **Do** put every new section in `aparencia.painel("<name>")` in story order.
**Do** size numbers from the magnitude ramp only (2 / 1.25 / 1 / 0.8125 rem), with tabular numerals.
**Do** draw edges with the one hairline alpha (0.18 dark / 0.14 light).
**Do** let charts take the theme colorway; put the highlighted series first.
**Do** add a light and a dark variant for any new appearance and test it for WCAG AA.
donts: **Don't** add hover states, lifts or translations to panels.
**Don't** set gradient or clipped-background text on the nameplate or headings.
**Don't** override native text, widget or dataframe colors; repaint grounds, panels and hairlines only.
**Don't** shorten or lengthen a chart colorway from ten.
**Don't** inject appearance CSS in Padrão do Streamlit beyond the picked-segment rule; the band keeps its own styles.
